Activate the six real selected UI providers during the original product build.

The original complete preinstall and privilege documents are retained as exact
predecessors. Existing entries and the user-grant policy are preserved. Each
prebuilt HAP fingerprint comes from actual verification of its pinned complete
HAP, while LocationDialog and CommunicationSetting use the existing OS source
signer. LocationDialog retains its original normal APL, system-app feature,
ACLs and all profile fields except the signing leaf and expiry.

This is package input preparation. Only business, boundary, regression and
cleanup observations from the newly packaged QEMU image can accept behavior.
